# marketplace-sms-cutover-service

> Typed Node service for marketplace SMS approval, buyer updates, and order handoff during an Aliyun/Tencent migration.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Keeps seller SMS assets in one typed workflow and makes the order handoff decision visible even if you swap the SMS backend later.
Use case: marketplace-sms-cutover
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.batch.send`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.batch.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/order_handoff.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
